title: Woman deceived ex-partner that she had given birth to his babies, judge rules
description: The man paid his ex-partner around £30,000 over two years believing she had given birth to his children.

title: Northwestern Wildcats christen new Ryan Field with impressive win over Penn State Nittany Lions
description: Northwestern christened the new $875 million Ryan Field with a dominant 34-13 win over Penn State, racking up 413 rushing yards in the Big Ten clash.
